title: A story in order
label: ch:gu-a-story-in-order
canDo: I can join two actions with the -īne form (jaīne, khāīne) and -yā pachī, keep a story in order with pahelā̃, pachī, tyār pachī and chevṭe, and read a short story told in the past.

payoff.summary: Complete GU-R276-a-story-in-order: tell a short story in order, and read one.
